course_name: 進階全球及永續議題英文(一)
outline:
本課程旨在幫助學生提升對全球永續發展目標（SDGs）及當前全球性議題的理解，並能夠用英文進行有效的溝通與表達。學生將學會如何以英文探討全球性問題，如貧窮、氣候變遷、性別平等等，並能在學術、專業及公共討論中自信地發表意見。
This course is designed for undergraduate students to develop their academic English language skills for success in English-medium university coursework. This course will engage students with active participation in a variety of academic listening, reading, writing, and speaking activities that they would encounter in real-life academic university lectures and professional workplace environments.

Learning Objectives
By the end of this course, students will be able to:
1. Recognize how everyday life is shaped by larger social and environmental systems.
2. Use English to explain a sustainability issue, evaluate information, and lead an activity that helps others discuss and learn about the issue.
3. Experiment with one meaningful sustainability action and reflect on what it reveals about the system behind it.

flexible_learning.outcome:
Week 17+18: Revisiting the Course

Reading: Students revisit one activity, topic, or question from the semester that changed how they understand sustainability. They review their earlier classwork and identify what they understand differently now.

Writing: Students write a short epilogue about one question they want to continue exploring or one idea they may carry into daily life. They will add this reflection to the class Google Doc.

assessment:
Assessments

Student-led activity 10%
Speaking performance 10%
Classwork portfolio 20%
Sustainability experiment 20%
Writing performance 10%
Participation 30%

Because this is an ESP course, speaking and writing each account for 10% of the final course grade and will be assessed through course activities. A CEFR B2-or-higher result in Speaking or Writing from BESTEP or another recognized test gives the student full credit for that corresponding 10% component. Students without B2 earn the grade through the regular course assessments. All students must participate in the speaking and writing activities.

AI Policy:
The type of AI use allowed will be specified for different task. Students are discouraged from using generative AI as a shortcut for language production, critical thinking, and independent projects. This course is a place to practice discovering ideas and making choices for yourself, which matters more than quickly generating smooth English.
